notes.title: The only constant thing is change.
notes.notes:
[p]Hey folks, Ariano here, the solo developer and creator of [b]Craftlings[/b]. I am writing to you in my own name to give you some heads-up on things going on with the game right now.[/p][p]I would like to start and recap what happened so far and how grateful I am to be here, despite the fact that certain things did not always go optimal in the past.[/p][p]To be honest, it has been an incredible journey for me in the last 3 years! Full of emotions, ups and downs, with big opportunities and wins and also some heavy crisis and doubts – all needed for great learning and boosting my XP level![/p][p][b]Craftlings[/b] is my first Steam project. It started as a hobby during my parental leave back in 2022 when my kid was in kindergarten. Of course, I have dreamed about building something which could sustain my life as solo developer – who is not? But as I said, it was just a dream at that point.[/p][p]In January 2023 I should go back to work, and before that I wanted to release a demo and see what you think about the game in its current state.[/p][p]From this moment, plenty of things have changed… I got laid off, but the demo got some great attention. It was even streamed by a big German streamer, Gronkh, to 28.5k viewers!
I gathered a few thousand wishlists in just a few months and had to make an important decision – what to do next?[/p][p]On the one hand, I was forced to secure my family financially – as simple as quickly getting a job would do this! On the other hand, I wanted to continue working on Craftlings. I felt that with family duties I could not do both in parallel.[/p][p]After a longer discussion with my wife, we decided I should stay at home and continue working on Craftlings – [i]The Settlings[/i] at that moment, for those who still remember the old working title :)[/p][p]With some savings and a limited amount of money for living, I should try to secure some funding and find a way to build the game. I guess it was quite naive to believe that I could do this, having just a few thousand wishlists and some traction on Twitter, but I had to try it. I felt that life was telling me I have to go for it![/p][p]While working on new versions of the game and constantly updating the demo based on your feedback in 2023 and 2024, I also put a lot of effort into marketing. I was quite active on Twitter and also ran paid ads with really limited money on different platforms, trying to find a way to simply just get seen. This effort and the additional time spent on building relationships with influencers and participating in several Steam events helped quickly to reach over 50k wishlists.[/p][p]The momentum was there, publishers started knocking on the door. Next to the game development and marketing work, I also started a series of workshops on how to create and run a company in the game industry in Germany. This was an additional and necessary thing in my eyes that I had to do to increase my chances for sustainable success and also protect myself from making simple mistakes, since I am not a native German speaker and not a German citizen.[/p][p]Still with limited money for living but with huge hopes for the future, I started talking to several publishers. During this time, in the negotiations, I learned a lot about how the game industry actually works and what my position is in the hierarchy. I learned how fast some scouts can get excited about the game after seeing a big YouTuber playing the demo and how the excitement diminishes once you start talking about concrete steps, needs, deadlines, and scope![/p][p]I was incredibly lucky that I even had the chance to go through it, and in the end I secured a deal which gave not only the desired financial security for plenty of months but also some extra resources for additional work on audio & visuals and a significant marketing budget![/p][p]This changed my life. I was optimistic, and I met great people who helped me bring Craftlings to a new visual level, with Milan and Dubi from Croatia putting their hearts into improving the look and feel of the game – thank you guys for your hard work![/p][p]I had financial security and could focus only on game development, leaving a game with 85k wishlists to a team of professionals who would lift it even higher! And I did it – I thought that if I worked hard, stayed transparent, and was a good team player, with a game that had strong momentum on social media and an easy-to-understand, strong marketing hook – everything would be good, right?[/p][p]And things changed again... The publishing contract was terminated. I am not allowed to talk about anything what happened, what was inside the contract, what the consequences are for me, how the cooperation went, what I did, what they did — absolutely nothing...[/p][p]I was aware of the fact that a sudden termination can happen while signing the contract, but my initial optimism, need for financial security and the great marketing performance of Craftlings that I achieved with limited money in 2023 and 2024 completely covered the fear this might ever happen.[/p][p]Unfortunately I was wrong and my life changed again in just a matter of days. I lost my financial security; I now have an unfinished game.
Why did it happen? I really don’t know, but at that point it doesn’t even matter anymore! The world is moving fast, things change all the time, and the whole publisher story is already past. I want to look ahead and find paths to bring a great game to you. I don’t want to disappoint the 125k of you who wish the game will release at some point soon! So now I have to answer the question again: what to do next?[/p][p]And I can promise you that I will do my best to find a way to finish and release Craftlings soon. I just need some time to create a plan. I have to wear multiple hats again, find alternative paths for going forward, estimate personal risks, design the final scope, implement missing parts and — last but not least — recharge my human batteries.[/p][p]Believe it or not, as grateful as I am for everything that happened to me and to the game (I have probably reached more than most starting indie developers dream of), it cost me a few hit points and I need them back to be able to finish and release the game.[/p][p]So if you want to help, do not turn away from Craftlings — have some understanding of my current situation and the short break I need now, and give me a 💙 or whatever you want to share with me in the comments.[/p][p]Thank you for being here, for reading this, and for your patience![/p][p]Coming back to you soon,
Ariano – an independent game developer[/p]

notes.title: Earth Appreciation Festival & Demo Extension
notes.notes:
We’re delighted that Craftlings is included as part of the Earth Appreciation Festival until [b]8 April 2025[/b], and we decided that we’d extend our free demo until then too!

In recognition of World Earth Day which takes place at the end of April, this event celebrates the beauty of our planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/81935a3d0caf62b978cfa44e3e4a2722a52182e7.jpg[/img]

Craftlings is a resource-management strategy game and building your settlement for your hapless craftlings uses a lot of natural resources from the world around you. In order to start building you’ll need to gather elements like wood and stone, advancing production as you expand and upgrade. Those resources are not infinite, so you really have to consider how you use them, and how you replenish them.

One of the key elements of Craftlings is always ensuring that you have enough resources, money and craftlings to advance forward as a civilization. You’ll need to budget, build an economy and even plant trees to make sure your craftlings have everything they need to not only survive, but to thrive!

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNjdsaDZ6N255YTA4a3Rjd3pxcXF0M3RyYjJweTJrMWthczhiOTMyNCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/IPw9tdAEYrWjRFi2id/giphy.gif[/img]

It’s been wonderful to see so many of you try to wrangle the Craftlings into motivated and organized civilization-builders.

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOGQ3emJiM3oxdWU2M216bGU5YzdpNGZvNWQzZ3R3bXE5Nm8wMHlkbyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/IUfWN92QNNuXBqjvuy/giphy.gif[/img]

We were also thrilled with how many of you attempted the Winter Challenge Map and how incredibly well you all did. You really blasted our expectations into space along with a very large number of snowmen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/e6bd17e8ede0b2aa9812210beabae0818b68fad9.jpg[/img]

Thanks for all the feedback from players about the demo, we're listening and taking it all onboard. While we've removed the demo for now, it's something we'd like to release again in the future once we've had time to review your comments and suggestions. When we have more news to share, we'll let you know.

[h3]So, What’s Next for Craftlings?[/h3]

We’re still working hard on Craftlings and we’ll have more news to share about what’s coming next and the release of the game in the coming months. The best thing to do to keep up to date is to follow us on our social media or join our Discord.

Thank you for all your support of Craftlings, don’t forget to Wishlist the game if you haven’t done so already and once again, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Winter Challenge Map ⛄❄🚀
notes.notes:
The festive season is fast approaching and it’s never too early to start celebrating. 🎄🥳 

What better way to get into the spirits of the season than playing our Winter Challenge Map and sending some snowmen into space? Let me explain. 

[h2]What is a Challenge Map? [/h2]

Alongside the main campaign of Craftlings we will be including Challenge Maps for players to test their skills and achieve specific objectives within a one-hour time limit. These maps DO NOT have a save option so you really have to test yourself to achieve the highest score you can for the global leaderboards. 

We will be adding Challenge Maps to Craftlings regularly as part of an ongoing rotation, so keep your eyes peeled and the demo installed for some fun surprises.  

The first Challenge Map for Craftlings is the Winter Challenge Map ❄⛄. 

[h2]What is the Winter Challenge? [/h2]

As we mentioned earlier, the main objective of the Winter Challenge Map is to build snowmen and send them into space.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/94958ab9864b6dab827a6a3f26f709f0a102d77b.gif[/img]

Build a firework rocket and launch as many snowmen into space as you can before the time runs out, sounds simple...right? Well, you’ve still got to build and gather resources to get to that point, so you’ll really put those skills you’ve learned in the campaign to the test.  

The Winter Challenge Map will be available until the end of December and we even have a special channel on our Discord server specifically to share the results of your efforts, so don’t be shy, show us how well you did! 
 
The demo and Winter Challenge Map are available to play for free NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274180/Craftlings_Demo/

notes.notes:
It’s been a very busy week!!! 

Not only did we change the name of our game from The Settlings to Craftlings, announced our partnership with Raw Fury and showcased our brand-new trailer at the PC Gaming Show but we also updated our demo on Steam! 🥳🎉

[previewyoutube=AD-ndyigEQM;full][/previewyoutube]

For long time followers of the game, and new players who are just curious, let us tell you about the demo and what has been updated, improved and what is new 👀
[list]
[*]2 unique maps forming part of the single player campaign 
[*]Implemented an improved progression system allowing you to unlock new items as you progress through the demo 
[*]Removed the Bank Challenge Map 💵– thank you for playing! 
[*]Added a new Winter Challenge Map ❄⛄🚀 - make sure you check that out!  
[*]Upgraded the objective of each level to have clearer guidance, while still letting you find their own solution to complete the objectives. 
[*]Visuals have had a full overhaul and there's a new pixel art style and new building animations to bring the world to life. 
[*]Implemented updates to the UI and changes to the way you interact and interface with the game 
[*]Renewed mechanics and adjustments to the way you play 
[*]Added a completely new way to gather stones 
[*]Introduced drones for automated item collections 
[*]Introduced a chest for resource storage  
[*]Reworked dynamite 🧨: You can now use dynamite to remove items from the world and add them back into your inventory.  
[*]Introduced a new economy system for tool production. 🔨⛏ 
[*]Added a floating barrel with small rewards. Listen for the cry of the seagull to know when the barrel is arriving.  
[*]Introduced an additional option to prevent all resources being consumed by buildings, allowing resources to pass to other areas of the settlement. This means you don’t have to manually close and reopen them. 
[*]New ladder placement system with placement preview. No more misplaced ladders!  
[*]Assorted QOL updates and bug fixes. [/list]
[h2]The demo is available to play for free NOW: [/h2] https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274180/Craftlings_Demo/

We’d like to thank everyone who has played the demo so far, left a review, streamed or made youtube videos and told their friends. Your support is massively appreciated! 

To keep up to date with Craftlings news follow us on our social media or join our community [url=https://www.discord.gg/craftlingsgame]Discord[/url] and don’t forget to wishlist Craftlings. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771110/Craftlings/

notes.title: Banking Challenge
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Firstly, I wish you all a Happy New Year!

What a year it has been - 2023 surpassed all my expectations. We went from 4k WL to 44k WL. Thank you for your support!

Now, let's get back to business.

In honor of the ongoing Steam Capitalism and Economy Fest, I've created a new challenge for you. You can access it from the main menu, and you have 1 hour of in-game time to collect as many coins as possible with your central bank account!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/92e4a1ae4cf30326341ea28c4ca55d398c37428d.png[/img]

A brand new map has been specially designed for this challenge.

On the map, you'll find a newly added quest building - the Central Bank - which you can interact with!

Every 180 seconds, you'll receive a 5% interest on the money you've deposited. You can use this interest to expand your settlement or deposit it directly into your bank account!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/8ddbf070b1efe40d5c388bf0cf58a98cc7c35d7d.png[/img]

If you successfully complete the challenge with a minimum of 500 coins, you can submit your score on [url=https://discord.com/invite/zfyc9Gj2Vb]Discord[/url] and receive a unique role!

To get the legendary "Market Shark" role on Discord, you must demonstrate your skills!

Will you venture into selling wood or planks? Perhaps engage in gold mining or sculpture production? Or will you send your soldiers to battle skeletons, collect bones, and sell them in the local market?

The choice is yours. Good luck and have fun!

Don't forget to wishlist ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771110/The_Settlings

notes.title: Save & Load
notes.notes:
Hi,

I just released a new version of the demo over the weekend.

The main focus of my work was on the Save & Load System, and I'm happy to say that it's now implemented and working well. The game automatically saves when you exit to the main menu, and you can load it from there. Please note that the save feature only works for the regular game, and challenge maps are not saved.

Additionally, I've added a small progress system within the game. This system gradually unlocks new buildings, items, or spells. At the beginning, each player can only build a few buildings until a Townhall is constructed. The Townhall has 4 levels, and with each upgrade, more things are unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/ba5bffe80b86056c2289684f2ce235142dd917dd.png[/img]

There are some changes in crowd control as well. After considering your feedback and having several discussions, I've decided to remove the limitation of having only 1 Settlings on ladders and bridges. I understand that this restriction felt a bit unintuitive.

While the limitation served a specific purpose by dividing Settlings traffic in different map areas, I recognized the need for a more flexible approach. To address this, I've introduced an automatic splitter dummy. This dummy reacts and changes its states on each interaction, preventing every second Settling from passing.

I believe this is a powerful tool that not only helps in dividing traffic into different areas but also allows control over the amount of traffic in those areas. It can be combined with other items for even more effects. I encourage you to test it and find creative ways to use it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/51ffc3def9397da84e4a08e7d22a8d6e77ac883e.gif[/img]

[h3]What is comming next:[/h3]

In the upcoming weeks, my main focus will continue to be on improving the game. I'll be adding quality-of-life features, necessary items for better automation, and fine-tuning the game balance for current demo.

I'm considering removing the tutorial map and instead integrating a simpler tutorial directly into the main game. Given the Townhall mechanic, I'm thinking of incorporating a straightforward tutorial that guides players through the initial phase of the game until the Townhall is constructed.

This is the plan, and I'm eager to see how it unfolds :)

Thank you, everyone, for being around!

Best,
Ariano

notes.title: What Next?
notes.notes:
Before I talk about the changes I made in the recent update and what the next steps are, I have to share with you this one picture. This has been made by a player from the Discord server, and as I saw it, I became speechless! Crazy things happening...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/5fd3c678442d31c20104de87edddaf93a98bc737.png[/img]

Despite bug fixes, I've made some changes to address some of the issues you reported recently:

1.) The Vegetable Beds can now be turned off/on like other small constructions. This should help to manage the vegetable load in the settlement. 

2.) Regarding hammer softlock: On destroying the building, the player will get a hammer in addition to the blueprint. I introduced it to reduce frustration, especially for new players.

[h3]Full changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed bug where resources / tools disappear from settling after changing vegetable type in vegetable bed
[*] added option and a sprite to allow closing a vegetable bed
[*] added text to miner shed and builder house explaining how to get carrots
[*] added text to hammer tool-tip explaining that destroying building with dynamite gives you a hammer back
[*] fixed bug where only cargo goods could be set as filter on bridge placement
[*] fixed bug where on the demo "small island" map there was one invisible block where nothing could be build on. 
[*] fixed bug where clicking on the top bar opens old, broken shop menu
[*] fixed bug where Settling could walk on a button appeared over the building
[*] fixed bug where blocks remains blocked after killing Octopus boss
[*] reduced the probability (not shore if fixed) Settling stuck in jump animation after receiving a tool
[*] fixed bug where settling parachuting with the item above a balloon will stuck in air
[*] potential fix for Trees areas getting rarely blocked by invisible things where no new trees can be spawned from saplings (potential because I can not reproduce it)
[*] added small victory screen for finishing the demo map objectives. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/081d4f15dfddab29ded1d5983b3ebf3602c6cd4f.gif[/img]

[h3]What is comming next:[/h3]
Probably, some of you already know that I am developing this game alone, and everything, including marketing and finding ways to finance the project, is on my shoulders. That is why things may take some time, and I cannot always dedicate 100% of my time to game development.

I can share with you at this point that I have made some significant steps toward becoming a full-time indie developer. I want to achieve this to be able to focus only on producing a great and fun game. As soon as I have some concrete things I can share, I will do it immediately. So stay tuned.

This does not mean I won't do anything for the game or update the demo. My current focus is to address some issues that have been reported on the Discord server. I want to make the game experience great for any type of player: the veterans, and we have plenty of them, but also new players to make the path of becoming a veteran an enjoyable experience.

One big thing that is missing is the Save & Load system. I want to do it as soon as possible, but I also have to refactor a bit of the code and add necessary functions that will support this whole system.

My focus in the next weeks would be to build the Save & Load System, add necessary new player features and Quality of Life (QoL) features, and improve the overall quality of the game.

This means that there will be no big content updates/new resources/buildings/game mods, or new levels in the near future.

Thank you, everyone, for being around!

Best,
Ariano

notes.title: Octopus & The Traveler - Update
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that on August 3rd I will launch a big update for The Settlings Demo including new map, new mechanics and many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/e23feeef0f9ba9bccd8c7f53a429826ea03cf74b.png[/img]

What's New:

[list]
[*] New Map with unlimited playtime - Forest Island
[*] New water Boss: Octopus!
[*] New Mechanic: Auto-shooting with Ballista for water Bosses
[*] New Building: Siege Workshop where you produce bolts for Ballista
[*] New Reward System on building placement
[*] New UI with instant buy from the bottom bar
[*] New Tutorial map: 10-minute experience for new players
[*] New Tooltip system for buildings, inventory & spells
[*] New 2-level house upgrade system
[/list]

Other changes:

[list]
[*] Old tutorials have been removed
[*] The old demo map has been moved to the challenge mode and remains the same
[*] Different starting conditions
[*] The game starts in fullscreen
[*] All critical and major bug fixes
[/list]

What is still missing:
A LOT!
Now, seriously: save system & celebration screen for finishing the lighthouse

About me and what's next:
As some of you may know, I am solo developing this game. It started as a hobby project back in Summer 2021, and for now, it is still a hobby project...
But I am trying to use all my skills and do my best to find a way to go full-time game dev and build a great, engaging, and fun game - on those foundations we build together!
Because without you, without your support, I wouldn't even have a chance to dream about an indie dev career!

So stay tuned, and I will try to update you more regularly about what is going on :)

Best,
Ariano

notes.title: Alpha v0.2 User Test
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

I am happy to announce that I have achieved my development goals for the next test phase 😃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/96abaf942c4305f311528788ce5d11bee25522f2.gif[/img]

The test starts at Monday 12.12.22 and will last for at least 1 week. Everyone is welcome! Use the steam page for registration.

The main goal of the test is not to find as many bugs as possible - although I have to say that I did my best to fix as many as I could! - the main focus of the test is to validate the core mechanics of the game.

I have changed plenty of things based on your feedback from the pre-alpha test from April this year and I am loocking forward to get more from you ;)

There is one more think I want to share about the current version. There is a time limitation for 1h per run, which will not be included in the final version. I am trying to find the best way of providing demo content for future demo and steam events. 

Regarding ballancning I have spent some time preparing the demo but I am complytely open for any suggestions or comments this regard. 

Happy testing!
Ariano
